Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000752": The reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; as of 2025-09-23 it uses the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000746": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer relies on the ledger service; it uses the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000743": The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000739" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000702" [decision]: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000697": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the handover doc for Diego for the authentication gateway handover to Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000685" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-05, the Cinder team says to page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000673": The Cinder team observed on 2025-09-03 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: authentication gateway, runtime upgrade, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000653" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000575": As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000563": On 2025-07-17, Yuki Tanaka handed the Cinder pager to Diego on rotation day.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000480": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000417" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, cache change)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000085": Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
